note: Family campground on a 60-acre private spring-fed lake near Belmont, with a beach, boat launch and boat rentals; the lake is for campers only. ATVs can ride from the sites onto the Tri-County trail system. Mostly seasonal: about 95 of its roughly 245 sites are sold by the night. The lakefront nightly sites are a few lettered water/electric sites (A and D on the map) and two tent sites; the rest of the shore is seasonal. --Claude
summary: Operator site (rates, FAQ, home, ATV, seasonal, site map), Google and imagery read. PRICE GATE FAILS: ordinary 20/30-amp RV site $60-65 summer before 5.5% tax, no GS/discount/gateway. Fees re-based on the cheapest RV site ($50-80; non-electric sites are tent/group). ~95 of ~245 sites nightly. Lakefront kept on lettered sites A/D. OHV flag (ride from site).
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (price gate, private): the ordinary RV site is the '20/30 Amp Elec/Water Site $60.00 $65.00 $50.00 $70.00' (high-season weekdays / weekends / spring-fall / holidays), 50-amp and lakefront $70-80, all 'plus 5.5% state and local tax'. Only spring/fall (Apr 17-May 17, Sep 7-Oct 4) reaches $50. The $40-45 'Non-Elec/Non-Water Site' rate is for primitive tent and phone-only group sites. Not a Good Sam Park (stored false), no operator member discount posted, gateways.py: none within 40 km (nearest Wisconsin Dells 104 km). Google 4.3 (229).
STORED FEES were based on the non-electric tent/group rate ($40-50 with a $20 electric surcharge); re-based on the 20/30-amp site ($50 spring/fall low, $80 holiday high), surcharge cleared.

LONG-STAY: site map marks 149 yellow 'SEASONAL' sites (S1-S160) against about 90 overnight sites (O1-O88 incl. tent, pull-on and pull-through, plus OA, OD, O3A, O6A, O13a) and 6 group sites: nightly ~95 of ~245 (~39%). Posted nightly rates, online booking, no wording discouraging nightly guests; passes the five tests. Minimum stay 2 nights always (FAQ 'We require advance reservations with a two-night minimum stay'), 3 on holidays - under the 3+ standing threshold; stored booking row already carries it.

WATERFRONT: lakefront kept, narrowly. Nearly all shore sites are seasonal (S26-S41 on the dam-side point, S100-S108/S133-S139 along the west peninsula's shore road). The operator sells nightly 'Lakefront Water/Elec Site' rates and names 'Site A ... on the Lakefront' and 'Lakefront Site D' (map OA/OD, on the one-way shore road of the west peninsula, around 42.7774,-90.2975) plus tent sites T23/T24 'Along the Lakefront'. Imagery: an open grass strip 10-30 m wide with docks lies between that road and the water, so those sites sit within ~50 m over open ground. Exact positions of A/D on imagery not pinned; the note names them.

OHV (reviewer decides): 'Direct access from the campground to over 200 miles of ATV trails! (No need to trailer your ATV to the trails!)'; part of the Tri-County ATV Trail System; ATV gas sold at the office. Otherwise a lake/family campground (beach, boats, playgrounds, hayrides) - reads as general with an OHV side.
Adults-only groups must all be over 21 (not an age-restricted park).

PIN 42.7764,-90.2942 at the office/store between the two camping areas: fine. WEBSITE https://www.lakejoy.com/ and PHONE 608-762-5150 confirmed. Season: rate seasons run Apr 17 - Oct 4 (2026); 2027 dates not posted. booking (platform campspot) not re-read on Campspot. Inclusion evidence current.
